name: vite
purpose: Compile the React setup application into static assets served by the loopback installer process.
alternativesConsidered: A second standalone Vite toolchain unrelated to the repository's Vite Plus adoption
maintenanceStatus: Pinned to the same Vite Plus 0.2.6 release already adopted by the repository root.
securityEvidence: Exact official source commit, MIT package metadata, frozen registry integrity, and the packaged aggregate license file were inspected.
modifications: None; the package is installed under the Vite-compatible alias expected by its API and CLI.
requiredNotices: Retain the packaged MIT and third-party notices in LICENSE when redistributing built tooling.
